What happens when thousands of people panic at the same time?
Others wait, watching everyone around them.
When information is unclear, people often look to others for clues.
One person's reaction can influence the people nearby.
And that reaction can ripple through the crowd.
Uncertainty. No one knows what is happening.
Social influence. We copy the people around us.
And stress. So almost everyone heads for the one exit they know.
During an emergency, reliable information helps people stay calm and move safely.
People spread across the exits, and the crowd flows.
